in_sanskrit.name: Kivanth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kivanth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ki' meaning 'Lord' and 'Vanth' meaning 'Strength', Kivanth is a name that signifies power and might. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Hanuman, who is known for his immense strength and unwavering devotion to Lord Rama.
